snippet.title: The Mystery of Thebes | Marvel Rivals Season 9 Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
Unveil the mysteries hidden within the ancient world of Thebes with Season 9 of Marvel Rivals! 🏛️ 

As Apocalypse journeyed across a collapsing timeline, destiny drove him to collide with enemies old and new. But as faith deals a deadly hand, no one truly knows who can be trusted. 

A storm builds as a single mother attempts to put together the pieces of what was left behind. Help her track down an even more impenetrable shadow looming over newly uncovered murder mysteries. 

Sift through endless lies and uncover the one truth with Marvel Rivals Season 9: The Mystery of Thebes on July 10 UTC! 🔎
